eval: async function meas(fn, sec = 1.3) {     const off = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(44100 * sec), 44100);     const sc = AudioSys.ctx, sm = AudioSys.master, mut = AudioSys.muted;     AudioSys.ctx = off; AudioSys.muted = false;     const g = off.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.35;     const l = off.createDynamicsCompressor();     l.threshold.value = -12; l.ratio.value = 16; l.knee.value = 6;     g.connect(l); l.connect(off.destination);     AudioSys.master = g;     try { fn(); } finally { AudioSys.ctx = sc; AudioSys.master = sm; AudioSys.muted = mut; }     const d = (await off.startRendering()).getChannelData(0);     let peak = 0, sum = 0, last = 0;     for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) { const a = Math.abs(d[i]); if (a > peak) peak = a; sum += a * a; if (a > 1e-4) last = i; }     const zcr = (s, e) => { let z = 0; const a = Math.floor(s * 44.1), b = Math.floor(e * 44.1); for (let i = a + 1; i < b; i++) if ((d[i] >= 0) !== (d[i-1] >= 0)) z++; return z; };     return { peak: +peak.toFixed(3), rms: +Math.sqrt(sum / d.length).toFixed(4), lastMs: Math.round(last / 44.1), zcrEarly: zcr(5, 35), zcrLate: zcr(95, 125) }; } const fails = [], table = {}; for (const [key, stems] of Object.entries(ATTACK_SAMPLES)) if ((AudioSys.samples[key] || []).length !== stems.length) fails.push(key + ' loaded ' + (AudioSys.samples[key] || []).length + '/' + stems.length + ' attack samples'); for (const k of Object.keys(SFX)) {     const m = await meas(() => SFX[k]());     table[k] = { peak: m.peak, lastMs: m.lastMs };     if (m.peak < 0.01) fails.push(k + ' is silent (peak ' + m.peak + ')');     if (m.peak > 0.99) fails.push(k + ' clips solo (peak ' + m.peak + ')'); } const w = await meas(() => SFX.whoosh()); if (!AudioSys.samples.whoosh?.length && w.zcrLate >= w.zcrEarly * 0.7) fails.push('whoosh band does not fall: zcr ' + w.zcrEarly + ' -> ' + w.zcrLate); const c1 = await meas(() => SFX.clash()), c2 = await meas(() => SFX.clash()); if (c1.peak === c2.peak && c1.rms === c2.rms) fails.push('two clashes rendered identical - variance dead'); const hard = await meas(() => SFX.land(1)), soft = await meas(() => SFX.land(0.36)); if (hard.peak <= soft.peak) fails.push('land does not scale: hard ' + hard.peak + ' <= soft ' + soft.peak); const delayed = await meas(() => SFX.whoosh(0.2)); if (delayed.lastMs < 300 || delayed.lastMs > 400) fails.push('delayed swing lost its scheduling'); const light = await meas(() => SFX.hit_light()), heavy = await meas(() => SFX.hit_heavy()); if (heavy.rms <= light.rms) fails.push('heavy impact lost its weight'); const stack = await meas(() => { SFX.clash(); SFX.hit_heavy(); SFX.hit_heavy(); SFX.steel_edge(); SFX.whoosh_heavy(); SFX.block_metal(); }); if (stack.peak > 0.99) fails.push('double-trade stack clips: peak ' + stack.peak); table['_stack'] = { peak: stack.peak }; table['_whoosh_zcr'] = { early: w.zcrEarly, late: w.zcrLate }; return { pass: fails.length === 0, fails, table };
